Nine declared at 37f208249f: ycharts_freshness, ycharts_snapshot_metrics, ycharts_time_series, ycharts_fund_series and ycharts_search are SAFE, each making one YCharts GET through ycharts/client.py. ycharts_risk_return_scatter is SAFE: its POST /charts/scatter_plot_data.json sends only security ids and two metric names and returns chart data. graph_cypher is SAFE because the projection service opens Kuzu read_only=True (infra/aws/globgrph/projection_server.py KuzuAdapter.open_read_only). graph_status is SAFE: GET /health. opal_data_refresh_upload is IRREVERSIBLE_SEND (irreversible, native_undo None, blast files:2/pipeline_runs:1/served_data): it PUTs 2 PKLs and POSTs /trigger, which fires the live yang-pipeline; same class and flags as the fail-closed default, without the `unclassified` marker. Five declared at bcb48cf626 in integrations/schwab/integration.py, all SAFE; none places, changes or cancels anything at Schwab or in the silver data (the integration serves Opal's pinned silver snapshots from S3 under assumed read roles; SPEC.read_only=True, unchanged): schwab_get_access returns the caller's grant, scope summary and per-dataset availability; schwab_list_files lists the catalog's servable files for one master/dataset/date range; schwab_describe_dataset describes the granted fields from the pinned schema; schwab_query runs one bounded read-only job over the pinned objects. schwab_prepare_download is the one to read closely: it mints a 5-minute, single-use, identity-bound ticket record in the gateway's own access-state store (export.mint, put_runtime IF_ABSENT) and returns a link that re-runs the same grant-checked read; no source data or external state changes. Every schwab tool also writes the gateway's own audit record (schwab_audit.release). Tier reach, worker reading: integration tools dispatch through base.run_integration_tool, which enforces spec.min_tier; the per-tool class does not feed that path. The specs' min_tier values are unchanged (ycharts standard, opal_portal standard, globgrph read_only, schwab read_only). schwab is still not in ENABLED_INTEGRATIONS, so none of its tools is served.
